svg.aria-label: SYNTHWERK_VISION_: Every setting is an env var with this prefix. See .env.example. SYNTHWERK_VISION_LOG_*: LOG_LEVEL (INFO) and LOG_FORMAT (json). Logs are JSON lines on stdout. OTEL_*: OpenTelemetry. Set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to export traces, metrics and logs. any other prefix: Env vars with any other prefix are ignored. Rename old names in every .env and deployment
